name: Travel Authorization
description: Works out allowable trip costs, takes proof screenshots and fills the Kuali travel authorization as a draft for you to submit.
limitations: Personal project, not an official UAH tool. It never submits a form or pays for anything.

name: Travel Submission
description: Puts together the reimbursement packet after the trip.
limitations: Part of the UAH travel skill. UAH Business Services has the final say.

name: Brag
description: Turns the project you built into a short launch video with music and share copy.

name: Diagram/Sketch Generator
description: Turns scientific text into a checked illustration plan, an image prompt and an SVG or image.

name: Humanizer
description: Makes AI-written text sound like a person wrote it, without changing what it says.

name: Literature Review
description: Systematic, scoping and narrative reviews from PubMed, arXiv and Semantic Scholar.

name: Peer Review
description: Drafts a structured review of a manuscript or proposal.

name: CARE Lightweight
description: Design a new agent or skill in a structured way in about 20 minutes.
